releaseNotes:
Notes v1.8.13 (Build 185):
• Round video notes in view play muted and looping at their size, with no ring or buttons; a tap plays from the start with sound, full width
• Single clean progress ring without track or border
• Hug animation for 🤗 and 🫂; text message emojis animate on arrival and tap
• Calendar in chat search jumps to a day's first message
• Couple Connection: one edit button for all three fields
